test_graph_equality: test two graphs for equality checking nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test whether two graphs are isomorphic with same structure and arc properties
test_loadtxt_graph: test loading a graph from text format and verify it matches expected structure
test_savetxt_graph: test saving a graph to text format and verify the output matches expected lines
test_save_load_graph: test saving and loading a graph to/from binary format and verify equality
